study: Gersten et al. 2010, Teacher Study Group (TSG), AERJ 47(3)
delivery_evidence: TSG = 16 facilitator-led interactive sessions held at the school site twice a month from October to mid-June, ~75 min each; all on-site face-to-face (Method section, 'held at the school site twice a month').
test_alignment_evidence: All outcomes are broad independent standardized tests: Woodcock (WDRB) vocabulary/comprehension/decoding subtests and DIBELS ORF; flagged standardized_independent in extraction (Table 7).
curriculum_evidence: PD aimed to improve comprehension/vocabulary instruction within teachers' EXISTING core reading programs; 'the purpose of the TSG program was not to change a [curriculum]'; control schools only lacked TSG access (Method/Discussion).
outcome_timing_evidence: All effect sizes from the spring post-test at the end of the treatment year (Table 7; timepoint 'post, spring').
